integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from exact hyperbolic geometry and Taylor-series inversion. Numerical code is only a consistency check and does not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only geodesic disks in the curvature -1 hyperbolic plane are treated; the remainder depends on the fixed radius, and no arbitrary-body, higher-dimensional, or variable-curvature second-order formula is claimed.
title: Second-order hyperbolic illumination expansion for geodesic disks
